title: AutoMapper
description: A convention-based object-to-object mapper that eliminates repetitive mapping code.

data.text: AutoMapper is a convention-based object-to-object mapper. It uses a fluent configuration API to define how types map to each other, eliminating the need to write repetitive mapping code.

data.title: Installation
data.code:
dotnet add package AutoMapper
dotnet add package AutoMapper.Extensions.Microsoft.DependencyInjection

data.title: Mapping Configuration

terms.definition: A class that groups mapping configurations for maintainability.
Projects mapping into a LINQ query for efficient database queries.

data.title: Best Practice
data.text: Register AutoMapper with DI and use `IMapper` in your services.

data.title: Key Takeaways
data.takeaway: AutoMapper simplifies DTO mapping in ASP.NET Core applications.

data.title: Exercise
data.description: Map between two domain models using AutoMapper.
data.expectedOutcome: A mapped Destination object from a Source object.
